description.zh: 要新增授权用户的云电脑ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the cloud computers to which you want to add end users.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 要删除授权用户的云电脑ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the cloud computers whose end users you want to remove.

title.zh: 为便捷用户新增或删除云电脑授权

descriptions.zh: 只有状态为运行中（Running）的云电脑支持修改授权用户。
descriptions.en: You can modify end users only for cloud computers that are in the Running state.
